content.answer: Never rebuild an id-referenced single-select field by sending a fresh list of names — merge options by stable id: pass each existing option's original object (its old id) through unchanged, and assign fresh ids only to genuinely new names, numbered from max(existing id)+1, otherwise the API rebuilds every option with new ids and silently clears the field value on every existing row.
content.reuse_advice: For any id-referenced catalog/enum update: fetch the current option list first; match incoming entries to existing ones by stable id (pass original objects through untouched so ids never change); append only truly new entries with fresh ids continuing after max(existing id); never regenerate ids from names alone, because clients and stored rows reference ids, and remapping ids by name silently orphans/breaks all existing references.
